```{python}
#| echo: false
import os
from pptx import Presentation

prs = Presentation(os.path.join(r.loc, r.pptx_file))
titles = []
notes = []
for slide in prs.slides:
    t = slide.shapes.title
    titles.append(t.text.strip() if t else "")
    if slide.has_notes_slide:
        notes.append(slide.notes_slide.notes_text_frame.text.strip())
    else:
        notes.append("")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
titles <- py$titles
notes <- py$notes
slides <- list.files(slide_dir, pattern = "\\.svg$", full.names = FALSE)
nums <- as.integer(gsub("\\D", "", slides))
slides <- slides[order(nums)]

render_slides <- function(slide_indices) {
  for (i in slide_indices) {
    path <- file.path(slide_dir, slides[i])
    title <- if (i <= length(titles) && nchar(titles[i]) > 0) titles[i] else ""
    note <- if (i <= length(notes) && nchar(notes[i]) > 0) notes[i] else ""
    cat(sprintf('\n## %s {background-image="%s" background-size="contain" .hide-title}\n\n', title, path))
    if (nchar(note) > 0) {
      cat(sprintf('::: {.notes}\n%s\n:::\n\n', note))
    }
  }
}

render_slides(1:5)
```
